rule: Explicit/default: three measured repeats; hot/distributed 1000 operations; groups 100 operations.
Literal and uppercase normalized root DN remain separate; 1000 operations x 7; default access.
Final R16 NONROOT; 1000 operations x 7 per method/member/access/endpoint; first/last/missing and 10/1000 members remain separate.
Unadopted initial candidate; two independent 1000 x 7 group runs and original component logs preserved outside final statistics.
Independent explicit access: hot Base/Equality 1000 x 7 and group reads 100 x 7; no distributed, concurrent or Bind measurements.
Fixed counts before each run; no early stopping or repetition selected by favorable results.
Root-bound real UID handler with 1/1024 targets and Group1000 first/last/missing; three unprofiled 500ms repetitions per case. Setup is outside b.Loop.
Separate same-candidate missing-member handler benchmark for 10/1000 members, forced-owned and eligible modes; does not replace network results or baseline/current components.
SDK warmups and smoke JSON retained and excluded from medians; concurrent repeat 0 excluded.
Root-bound CLI; 8 workers x 1000 equality searches; three measured repeats per access mode.
Unrounded per-cell medians; every method and negative observation retained; no endpoint/access/identity pooling or aggregate parity claim.
Per-operation allocations are measured; retained heap is not measured.
Explicit text/JSON allowlist; no passwords, databases, LDIF/canonical contents, executable binaries or binary profiles. Exports and binaries are hashed only.
